div.head: Iud Dei VIII 2
div.ab: Ðis is oþer hals . . . . Ic halsie ðe, man, þurh ures Drihtnes geflæscnysse hælendes Cristes ⁊ þurh þises wæteres dóm ⁊ þurh þa halgan untodælendlican þrynnysse ⁊ þurh þa halgan englas ⁊ heahenglas ⁊ þurh ealle Godes halgan ⁊ þurh þone ondryslican domes dæg ⁊ þurh þa feower ⁊ twentig gecorenra, ðe dæghwamlice God heriað, ⁊ þurh þa twelf apostolas ⁊ þurh ealle halige þroweras ⁊ ealle andetteras ⁊ ealle halige fæmnan ⁊ þurh ealle þa heofonlican mægenðrymmas ⁊ þurh þa halgan þry cnihtas, þe dæghwamlice God heriað, ⁊ þurh ða hunteontig ⁊ feower ⁊ feowertig þusenda þrowera, þe for Godes naman cwylmede wæron, ⁊ þurh þæt fulluht, ðe þu on gefullod wære,

Dies ist andere Beschwör[ung]: Ich beschwöre dich, Mensch, bei der Fleischwerdung unseres Herrn, des Heiland Christus und beim [Gottes]gericht dieses Wassers und bei der heiligen untheilbaren Dreieinigkeit und bei den heiligen Engeln und Erzengeln und bei allen Heiligen Gottes und bei dem furchtbaren [jüngsten] Gerichtstage und bei den 24 Auserkorenen, welche täglich Gott preisen, und bei den 12 Aposteln und bei allen heiligen Märtyrern und allen Bekennern und allen heiligen Jungfrauen und bei allen himmlischen Mächten und bei den heiligen drei Jünglingen, die täglich Gott preisen und bei den 144000 Märtyrern, die um Gottes Namen getödtet worden sind, und bei der Taufe, in der du getauft worden bist,

This is another adjuration: I adjure you, man, by the incarnation of our Lord the Saviour Christ, and by the [divine] judgment of this water, and by the holy undivided Trinity, and by the holy angels and archangels, and by all God's saints, and by the dreadful [Last] Day of Judgment, and by the twenty-four elect who daily praise God, and by the twelve apostles, and by all holy martyrs and all confessors and all holy virgins, and by all the heavenly powers, and by the holy three youths who daily praise God, and by the 144,000 martyrs who were killed for God's name, and by the baptism with which you were baptised,

Or [with] this other adjur[ation] … I adjure you, man [named man?], by the Incarnation of our Lord, the Saviour Christ, and by the judgment of this water[-ordeal], and by the holy indivisible Trinity, and by the holy angels and archangels, and by all the saints of God, and by the dreadful Judgment Day, and by the 24 elect who daily praise God, and by the 12 apostles, and by all the holy martyrs, and by all the confessors, and by all the holy virgins, and by all the heavenly powers, and by the three holy youths who daily praise God, and by the 144,000 martyrs, who were killed for the name of God, and in [the name of] the baptism by which you were baptized,
